answers.name: Auto Tagger
answers.description: Tags new orders automatically by rules so merchants can filter and fulfil them faster.
answers.functionalities: Create rules such as 'order total over an amount', 'shipping country is' or 'contains a product' with a tag to add; Tag every new order that matches a rule; Show a log of which orders were tagged by which rule
answers.flow: The merchant installs the app, creates rules with the tag each should add, and turns them on. When a new order comes in, the app checks the rules and adds the tags. The merchant reviews the log in the app.
answers.plans: Basic: $0, up to 3 rules; Pro: $5/month, 7-day trial, unlimited rules

criteria: The architecture does not add a theme app extension, since shoppers see nothing.
Webhook handling is idempotent, so a redelivered orders/create does not tag twice or log twice.
The Basic plan's 3-rule limit is enforced on the server.
The log has a retention limit or pagination so it does not grow without bound.
Every admin screen has loading, empty and error states.
